sub_tasks.desc: Coder Agent: Implement Spring Boot service with @RestController annotation for attendance operations. Validate QR payload containing studentID and courseID in base64 format. Implement idempotent attendance recording using composite key (StudentID, CourseID, Date). Validate student-course enrollment relationship before recording attendance. Use prepared statements for all database operations to prevent SQL injection.

Coder Agent: Implement attendance table with all specified columns: attendance_id (UUID PK), student_id (UUID NOT NULL FOREIGN KEY Users.user_id), course_id (UUID NOT NULL FOREIGN KEY Courses.course_id), attendance_date (DATE NOT NULL), timestamp (TIMESTAMP NOT NULL DEFAULT now()). Add composite unique constraint on (student_id, course_id, attendance_date) to enforce idempotency. Create foreign key constraints to users and courses tables.

Tester Agent: Achieve minimum 85% code coverage for all attendance operations. Test idempotency logic for duplicate QR scans. Validate student-course enrollment validation. Test network connectivity drop scenarios with retry logic. Test input validation for malformed QR payloads.

Reviewer Agent: Validate OWASP compliance for all input handling and database operations. Check for proper exception handling and error reporting. Verify RBAC enforcement for attendance operations. Ensure proper logging and audit trail implementation.
